Hi Jordan —

Thanks for trying the widget and for the interest in Redwood. I’m Rachel on the Sales team; I picked up the handoff and would love to get a short demo scheduled so we can show a tailored flow for the data infra/analytics use case you mentioned in the intake.

Would any of these windows work for a 30–45 minute session? (I listed them in CET to match where your team is):
- Tue June 1 — 09:00–09:45 CET
- Wed June 2 — 14:00–14:45 CET
- Thu June 3 — 11:00–11:45 CET

If none of those fit, tell me 2–3 windows that work for you and I’ll coordinate. We typically do a short discovery + a product walkthrough; if you want we can invite a solutions engineer for a deeper technical segment (45 min). Attached is a short demo brief so you know what we’ll cover.

Thanks — looking forward to coordinating.

Best,

Appreciate the follow-up. Also, we’d like a 45-minute slot to include our Head of Data (Sara Lopez) and our platform engineer (Tom). They’ll want to see model routing and cost controls specifically.

Available windows for us next week (CET):
- Tue June 1 — 14:30–15:30 CET
- Thu June 3 — 10:00–11:00 CET or 16:00–17:00 CET
